initial_prompt: Who won the most recent Super Bowl?

messages.content: Who won the most recent Super Bowl?

Based on the latest available information (as of my last check), the most recent Super Bowl was Super Bowl LVIII on February 11, 2024, where the **Kansas City Chiefs** defeated the San Francisco 49ers 25-22 in overtime. Patrick Mahomes was named MVP.

If you're asking after February 2025, that would be Super Bowl LIX—let me know if you need an update!
